MORE:
Switching Technologies Gunther Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulation 29 (1) (a) of the SEBI (listing Obligation & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (''Listing Regulations''), a meeting of the Board of Directors of Switching Technologies Gunther Limited (hereinafter referred to as ''the Company'') will be held on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 4:00 PM (IST) through Video Conferencing and other Audio Visual Means for the following matters: 

1. Approval of unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 

2. Other matters as per agenda of the Board meeting. 

Further, as per the code of conduct of the Company and pursuant to the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, the trading window has been closed for designated persons for declaration of the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
